description: This module allows for the manipulation of sudoers files.

parameters.name: commands
parameters.description: The commands allowed by the sudoers rule. Multiple can be added by passing a list of commands. Use ALL for all commands.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The name of the group for the sudoers rule. This option cannot be used in conjunction with user.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Specify the host the rule is for. Default: "ALL"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the sudoers rule. This is used for the filename for the sudoers file managed by this rule.

parameters.name: noexec
parameters.description: Whether a command is prevented to run further commands itself. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: nopassword
parameters.description: Whether a password is not required when command is run with sudo. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: runas
parameters.description: Specify the target user the command(s) runs as.

parameters.name: setenv
parameters.description: Whether to allow keeping the environment when command is run with sudo. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the rule should exist or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: sudoers_path
parameters.description: The path which sudoers config files are managed in. Default: "/etc/sudoers.d"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The name of the user for the sudoers rule. This option cannot be used in conjunction with group.

parameters.name: validation
parameters.description: If absent, the sudoers rule is added without validation. If detect and visudo is available, then the sudoers rule is validated by visudo. If required, visudo must be available to validate the sudoers rule. Choices: "absent" "detect" ← (default) "required"

examples:
- name: Allow the backup user to sudo /usr/local/bin/backup
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: allow-backup
    state: present
    user: backup
    commands: /usr/local/bin/backup

- name: Allow the bob user to run any commands as alice with sudo -u alice
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: bob-do-as-alice
    state: present
    user: bob
    runas: alice
    commands: ALL

- name: >-
    Allow the monitoring group to run sudo /usr/local/bin/gather-app-metrics
    without requiring a password on the host called webserver
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: monitor-app
    group: monitoring
    host: webserver
    commands: /usr/local/bin/gather-app-metrics

- name: >-
    Allow the alice user to run sudo /bin/systemctl restart my-service or
    sudo /bin/systemctl reload my-service, but a password is required
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: alice-service
    user: alice
    commands:
      - /bin/systemctl restart my-service
      - /bin/systemctl reload my-service
    nopassword: false

- name: Revoke the previous sudo grants given to the alice user
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: alice-service
    state: absent

- name: Allow alice to sudo /usr/local/bin/upload and keep env variables
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: allow-alice-upload
    user: alice
    commands: /usr/local/bin/upload
    setenv: true

- name: >-
    Allow alice to sudo /usr/bin/less but prevent less from
    running further commands itself
  community.general.sudoers:
    name: allow-alice-restricted-less
    user: alice
    commands: /usr/bin/less
    noexec: true
